limitations: Persistent majority reference contamination and sharp PSD curvature can bias noise.
Frequency/model mismatch, filtering and fading can bias local estimates.
Statistical uncertainty excludes model and interference bias.
Partial bursts describe observed symbols only.
Synthetic calibration and finite fixed-seed decode rates are not universal sensitivity guarantees.
documentation: Technical reference, field semantics, limits and reproduction commands; process evidence is structured validation data.
